oracle_execution.universal_because: the PROJECTION-ORACLE family; mutation exists in every ecosystem
oracle_execution.contract: No mutant record may exist without a kill_cause field splitting the kill by exception class (AssertionError vs everything else). not_applicable while unbuilt; on the first release that executes a mutant, an unsplit kill record is a REFUSAL. Evidence: Schuler & Zeller ICST 2011 Table III (a suite with every assertion deleted still detects >50% of the mutants the original detects; ~45% of kills are implicit runtime exceptions) and Zhang & Mesbah FSE 2015 (28-73% assertion-caused across five subjects). The amplification that matters here: gutting replaces bodies with `return None`, so Python callers raise TypeError/AttributeError on contact and a suite can post a near-perfect gutting kill rate with no assertion firing at all. Unsplit, the gutting probe would be the most flattering number in the lane.

order_dependence.universal_because: a property of a suite, not of a language

severity and fix-availability are discarded - this tier nominates and does not rank

pytest.static_self_skip.evidence: renaming JSON_DIR in @daemon made 75 tests silently vanish with the run still green (TAXONOMY corpus row 20); the SELF-SKIP shape ships fleet-wide via the branch template (corpus row 25)
pytest.static_self_skip.fix: make the skip condition read the MACHINE, never the SUBJECT. If the symbol's absence is the thing worth knowing, assert it instead of skipping on it.
pytest.static_self_skip.note: NOMINATION, NOT CONVICTION (Law M1). A row here says a test is suspect; it never says a test is worthless, and the M11 deletion probe that would settle whether a flagged test is safe to remove is not built in this release.

flags: the unit's only assert sits under an `if` whose `else` is absent or asserts nothing
the unit's only assert sits inside a `for` with no floor proving the iterable is non-empty
exempts: an `if` that asserts on BOTH branches is correct platform-divergent code and is never nominated (TAXONOMY known-good rows 2 and 3)
a loop preceded by an emptiness floor - `assert items`, a len() comparison, or a literal collection - is never nominated
a unit with any assertion at the top level of its body is never nominated: something in it always runs
limits: a floor established inside a fixture is not followed across the call
an `if` whose condition is statically always true still reads as a guard here
pytest.static_unentered_assert.evidence: 4 in @api half 1, 3 in @daemon, 1 in @backup, including an assertion that has never once executed (TAXONOMY corpus row 14) and a loop observed passing over an empty directory (corpus row 17)
pytest.static_unentered_assert.fix: assert the floor as well as the contents: `assert items` before the loop, or an else branch.
pytest.static_unentered_assert.note: NOMINATION, NOT CONVICTION (Law M1). A row here says a test is suspect; it never says a test is worthless, and the M11 deletion probe that would settle whether a flagged test is safe to remove is not built in this release.

pytest.scoped_survival.reason: not built - module gutting is not implemented in this release. When it is, it measures ORACLE SURVIVAL and is never to be read as pseudo-testedness (contract 2)

pytest.targeted_mutation.reason: not built - no mutant is executed by this release, so there is no kill to split and Law S9's kill_cause requirement has nothing to check yet (contract 1)

laws.L0: a test proves something when there EXISTS a change to production code that makes it fail
laws.M2: a measurement that agrees with you everywhere is not evidence
laws.M10: run suites against a copy - the instrument must not import the tree it measures
laws.M11: deletion-safety is a row-level probe, not a group
laws.S1: not-run is not_applicable with a reason, never 0
laws.S3: no group vanishes without a retired_groups ruling
laws.S4: group_list is the published order and groups matches it exactly
laws.S5: a cache-served artifact is stamped and names what it cannot see
laws.S6: an AI-tier group may only nominate
laws.S7: an unscored group carries no score; no nomination carries a delete-family verdict
laws.S8: a scored group must declare what its instrument cannot see
laws.S9: no mutant record without a kill_cause split
laws.T10: a run that cannot catch its own planted canary refuses to publish
laws.T-BUDGET: an execution group that exhausts its budget is refused, never measured

m10_proof.how: content hash plus stat fields, before the copy and after teardown
m10_proof.note: st_ctime alone does NOT catch a same-tick forge-then-restore - measured, so content is hashed rather than inferred
